company_type: Established Indian giant, subsidiary of Tata Power

technology.technology_name: TOPCon Bifacial Solar PV Module (Made-in-India ALMM-listed)
technology.description: Tata Power Solar manufactures high-efficiency monocrystalline solar PV modules using TOPCon (Tunnel Oxide Passivated Contact) cell architecture in bifacial M10/G12 wafer formats. India's oldest integrated solar manufacturer (since 1989) with a 2 GW expansion plant announced for module assembly.
technology.problem_solved: Reduces LCOE for utility-scale solar by 8–12% vs PERC modules through higher efficiency (>22%) and bifacial gain on tracker installations.
technology.innovation_summary: Indigenous TOPCon line, ALMM-listed, with thermal performance optimised for Indian climate (40–55°C ambient).
technology.unique_selling_points: ALMM Tier-1 manufacturer; Tata Group backing; pan-India service network; PLI scheme participant
technology.keywords: TOPCon, bifacial, ALMM, monocrystalline, M10, G12, India solar manufacturing
technology.application_area: Utility-scale solar, C&I rooftop, residential solar, solar pumping
technology.target_industries: Independent Power Producers, EPC companies, DISCOMs, government solar programmes
technology.potential_customers: NTPC, SECI tender winners, state-level developers, C&I aggregators
technology.institution_name: In-house R&D; partnerships with NCPRE-IIT Bombay
technology.dsir_recognition_status: Yes — Tata Power Solar holds DSIR recognition for in-house R&D unit
technology.estimated_market_size: Indian solar module market: ~₹70,000 Cr by 2030
technology.preferred_license_type: Quick License for incremental process improvements; Patent Buyout for novel cell chemistries
technology.royalty_expectation: 2–4% for process tech; 4–6% for novel cell IP
technology.upfront_cost: ₹50L–₹5 Cr range depending on IP strength
technology.certification_status: ALMM Tier-1, BIS, IEC 61215, IEC 61730, MNRE-approved
technology.routing_tier: Hybrid — Quick License for process IP, Patent Buyout for novel chemistries
